claims.content: Ensure accurate and timely classification of tracks to support friendly force awareness and threat response

goal.raw_text: Ensure accurate and timely classification of tracks to support friendly force awareness and threat response

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has received a track report (e.g., J2 PPLI message) that requires identity classification.
The track is not yet classified under one of the standard identity definitions: Pending, Unknown, Assumed Friend, Friend, Neutral, Suspect, or Hostile.
If the track is an exercise track, the Exercise Indicator in the J3 track messages must be set to distinguish it from live tracks.
Correlation restrictions do not apply if manual correlation is performed or if no conflicting conditions exist per paragraph 4.4.4.3.1f.
For inactive or limited status interface units, reporting rules for real-time tracks must be followed if local sensor data is correlated.
Receipt of a J2 PPLI message, detection of decorrelation criteria being met, or receipt of a Drop Track message (J7.0) for an Interface Unit.

trigger.raw_text: Receipt of a J2 PPLI message, detection of decorrelation criteria being met, or receipt of a Drop Track message (J7.0) for an Interface Unit.

claims.content: The C2 JU assigns a standard identity to the track based on its characteristics, behavior, origin, or nationality using one of the following definitions: Pending (not yet subjected to identification), Unknown (evaluated but not identified), Assumed Friend (assumed friendly due to characteristics/behavior/origin), Friend (belonging to a declared friendly nation), Neutral (neither supporting nor opposing friendly forces), Suspect (potentially hostile), or Hostile (declared belonging to an opposing entity).

If the track is involved in an exercise and is a live track, the C2 JU sets the Exercise Indicator in the J3 track messages to distinguish it from other live tracks; only tracks with standard identity of Friend can be modified by the exercise identity.

The C2 JU may further amplify the track’s identity using Special Interest Indicator, Exercise Indicator, Identity Amplifying Descriptor, Specific Type, Platform, Platform Activity, and Identity Confidence fields as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1.

For retransmission purposes, if the C2 JU assumes R² for a previously-reported track, it shall accept all defined field values for retransmission and operator appreciation regardless of actual values implemented by the originating C² JU.

If the C2 JU holds locally derived data that differs from the value accepted for retransmission (and is not No Statement), it shall report the locally derived data instead — except for non-NS data in Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit, which must be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, the C2 JU shall retransmit it as value 1 when assuming R².

Surveillance data reporting is initiated by the JU which first detects or initiates a track/point and makes it available for reporting on the interface; each track/point shall be assigned a TN from the JU’s allocated block at that time, and the JU shall have R² for the track/point.

The C2 JU may elect to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.

When accepting a remote ID change, the C2 JU shall also retain the received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields for retransmission and operator appreciation, except when controlling units apply specific rules (paragraphs 4.7.1.2b and c).

If a Platform, Platform Activity or Specific Type value of 0 (No Statement) is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU retains the local value as an exception to difference resolution rules.
If an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker Boom Only), or 8 (Tanker Drogue Only) is held locally and a different value is received, an operator alert is optional.
Differences in Environment/Category, ID, Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, Exercise Indicator and Special Interest Indicator field values may be resolved using the J7.0 (ACT = 2) message.

If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track, except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.
Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.

Simulated tracks will not be correlated with live tracks; prior coordination with all interface participants is required when transmitting simulated tracks to ensure they are not assigned TNs from other systems' TN blocks.

Automatic correlation shall be inhibited if the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict, unless systems have an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability to inhibit this automatic restriction.

Automatic correlation shall be inhibited if the two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current, unless systems have an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability to inhibit this automatic restriction.
Automatic correlation shall be inhibited if both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data.

Automatic correlation shall be inhibited if either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1; however, systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement.
The track is assigned a standard identity classification (Pending, Unknown, Assumed Friend, Friend, Neutral, Suspect, or Hostile) based on its characteristics, behavior, origin, or nationality.

If the track is an exercise track, the Exercise Indicator in the J3 track messages is set to distinguish it from other live tracks; only tracks with standard identity of Friend can be modified by the exercise identity.

The track’s identity may be further amplified using Special Interest Indicator, Exercise Indicator, Identity Amplifying Descriptor, Specific Type, Platform, Platform Activity, and Identity Confidence fields.
If correlation is not found, the C² JU integrates the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.

If decorrelation criteria are met, the PPLI and local track data are decorrelated, and the C² JU initiates a new surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number; the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IPF/SIF Indicator field are both reported as No Statement.

For inactive or limited status interface units, if reporting rules for real-time tracks apply, the C² JU assumes R² of the IU and reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG, with identity reported as Friend, and retains previously received PPLI values for Track Number, Platform, and Platform Activity.
Automatic correlation is restricted if conflicting conditions exist per paragraph 4.4.4.3.1f, unless operator-selectable capabilities are configured to inhibit such restrictions.
